headlines.title: The Financial Sector Is Shifting from Blocking AI Agents to Building an Authorization Layer
headlines.summary: The shift from blocking to building Financial institutions are currently caught in a high-stakes standoff with autonomous software. Major firms like Schwab and JPMorgan have responded to the proliferation of AI agents by implementing hard blocks. This defensive posture is driven by acute liability concerns.

headlines.title: Schwab and JPMorgan Block Unauthorized AI Agents from Moving Money as Private Ordering Reaches Financial Core
headlines.summary: On October 16, Charles Schwab CEO Rick Wurster confirmed in a Bloomberg TV interview that the firm is actively blocking unauthorized AI agents, such as Meta Muse, from executing transactions on behalf of clients.

headlines.title: AI Was Expected to Drain Charles Schwab’s Cash — CEO Rick Wurster Says Traders Are Doing the Opposite: ‘The More People Use AI, the More Cash They Hold’
headlines.summary: Charles Schwab Corp. President and Chief Executive Officer Rick Wurster said retail clients using artificial intelligence to support their trading are holding more cash than other active traders.

headlines.title: Bitcoin Bounces Off Its Lowest Point In A Month, But Charles Schwab’s Adam Lynch Warns A Midterms Risk
headlines.summary: Charles Schwab’s Lynch said BTC’s long-term fundamentals haven’t changed, even as Ethereum fell hard this year.

headlines.title: Fidelity, Schwab, and Vanguard Will Each Calculate Your RMD for You. None of Them Counts the IRA at the Other Two Firms, and the 25% Penalty on the Shortfall Is Yours
headlines.summary: Each of your IRA custodians hands you an accurate RMD figure every January, and trusting any one of them as your complete obligation can quietly trigger a federal excise tax the IRS assigns entirely to you.

description: The Charles Schwab Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a savings and loan holding company that provides wealth management, securities brokerage, banking, asset management, custody, and financial advisory services in the United States and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Investor Services and Advisor Services. It offers brokerage accounts with equity and fixed income trading, margin lending, options trading, futures and forex trading, and cash management capabilities, including money market funds, and certificates of deposit; third-party mutual funds through the Mutual Fund Marketplace and Mutual Fund OneSource service, as well as mutual fund trading and clearing services to broker-dealers; exchange-traded funds; advisory solutions for managed portfolios, separately managed accounts, customized personal advice for tailored portfolios, specialized planning, and full-time portfolio management; banking products comprising checking and savings accounts, first lien residential real estate mortgage loans, home equity lines of credit, and pledged asset lines; and trust custody services, personal trust reporting services, and administrative trustee services. It provides digital and software based trading platforms; research tools, and multichannel support, real-time market data, options trading; equity compensation plan sponsors full-service recordkeeping for stock plans, stock options, restricted stock, performance shares, and stock appreciation rights; retirement plan services; mutual fund clearing services; and advisor services, including interactive tools and educational content. The Company operates through branch offices. The Charles Schwab Corporation was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Westlake, Texas.
